item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory national-interest determination authorizing the specified drawdown; the legally consequential determination occurs in this segment, with later execution being ministerial implementation.","evidence":"I hereby determine that it is in the national interest of the United States to draw down articles and services"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently orders and authorizes the release of up to $45 million in Defense Department articles and services to the named governments; the legal commitment occurs through this directive itself.","evidence":"I direct the drawdown of up to $45 million of articles and services"}]}
